title: Constructed two-open transport for a composite scheme map
statement: For composable maps f and g with specified composite gf, opens U,V and local identifications phiU,phiV of A,B with restrictions of E, construct transportDataOfComposite. Its diagram is schemeComparisonFromRestrictions for g on the inverse-image opens, its kappa components are whiskered fixed pullback-composition comparisons, its site components are openSiteReturnIso, and each theta is kappa followed by inverse-site of phi followed by site. The component API is evaluation of these explicit fields.

proof.text: For composable maps f and g with specified composite gf, opens U,V and local identifications phiU,phiV of A,B with restrictions of E, construct transportDataOfComposite. Its diagram is schemeComparisonFromRestrictions for g on the inverse-image opens, its kappa components are whiskered fixed pullback-composition comparisons, its site components are openSiteReturnIso, and each theta is kappa followed by inverse-site of phi followed by site. The component API is evaluation of these explicit fields.

Store the fixed functors and beta maps directly. Construct each gamma as the explicit nested-site comparison, and use its proved forward coherence API. The uniqueness API identifies these maps with the former localization lifts. All existing functor, beta, kappa and site component statements remain unchanged.
Keep the existing restricted-composite local isomorphism construction behind no_expose. Its equation API is proved by reflexivity, so callers need not expand its geometric equality transport.
